#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

const long long MOD = 1000000007LL;
const long long INF = 1000000000000000001LL;

long long nCr[100][100];

long long f(long long p, int a, int b, int c, int d) {
    p = (p * nCr[a][b]) % MOD;
    p = (p * nCr[c][d]) % MOD;
    return p;
}

struct Tuple {
    long long d;
    int x, y, z;
    Tuple(long long d, int x, int y, int z) : d(d), x(x), y(y), z(z) {}
    bool operator<(const Tuple& other) const {
        if (d != other.d) return d > other.d;
        if (x != other.x) return x > other.x;
        if (y != other.y) return y > other.y;
        return z > other.z;
    }
};

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(NULL);

    int n, K;
    cin >> n >> K;
    int cnt1 = 0, cnt2 = 0;

    for (int i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j <= i; j++) {
            if (j == 0 || j == i)
                nCr[i][j] = 1;
            else
                nCr[i][j] = (nCr[i - 1][j] + nCr[i - 1][j - 1]) % MOD;
        }
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        int x;
        cin >> x;
        if (x == 50)
            cnt1++;
        else
            cnt2++;
    }

    long long dist[200][200][2];
    long long dp[200][200][2];
    for (int i = 0; i < 200; i++)
        for (int j = 0; j < 200; j++)
            for (int k = 0; k < 2; k++)
                dist[i][j][k] = INF;

    dist[0][0][0] = 0;
    dp[0][0][0] = 1;
    priority_queue<Tuple> pq;
    pq.push(Tuple(0, 0, 0, 0));

    while (!pq.empty()) {
        Tuple cur = pq.top();
        pq.pop();
        if (cur.d != dist[cur.x][cur.y][cur.z])
            continue;
        int x = cur.x;
        int y = cur.y;
        int z = cur.z;
        long long d = dist[x][y][z];

        if (z == 0) {
            int remX = cnt1 - x;
            int remY = cnt2 - y;
            for (int i = 0; i <= remX; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j <= remY; j++) {
                    if (i + j == 0)
                        continue;
                    if (i * 50 + j * 100 > K)
                        break;
                    long long ways = f(dp[x][y][z], remX, i, remY, j);
                    int nx = x + i;
                    int ny = y + j;
                    int nz = z ^ 1;
                    if (dist[nx][ny][nz] >= d + 1) {
                        if (dist[nx][ny][nz] > d + 1) {
                            dist[nx][ny][nz] = d + 1;
                            dp[nx][ny][nz] = (dp[nx][ny][nz] + ways) % MOD;
                            pq.push(Tuple(dist[nx][ny][nz], nx, ny, nz));
                        } else {
                            dp[nx][ny][nz] = (dp[nx][ny][nz] + ways) % MOD;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        } else {
            int remX = x;
            int remY = y;
            for (int i = 0; i <= remX; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j <= remY; j++) {
                    if (i + j == 0)
                        continue;
                    if (i * 50 + j * 100 > K)
                        break;
                    long long ways = f(dp[x][y][z], remX, i, remY, j);
                    int nx = x - i;
                    int ny = y - j;
                    int nz = z ^ 1;
                    if (dist[nx][ny][nz] >= d + 1) {
                        if (dist[nx][ny][nz] > d + 1) {
                            dist[nx][ny][nz] = d + 1;
                            dp[nx][ny][nz] = (dp[nx][ny][nz] + ways) % MOD;
                            pq.push(Tuple(dist[nx][ny][nz], nx, ny, nz));
                        } else {
                            dp[nx][ny][nz] = (dp[nx][ny][nz] + ways) % MOD;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    if (dist[cnt1][cnt2][1] == INF)
        cout << -1 << endl;
    else
        cout << dist[cnt1][cnt2][1] << endl;
    cout << dp[cnt1][cnt2][1] << endl;

    return 0;
}
